trust_decision.summary: Only a canonical locale module name may be appended to the dynamic require path: the key is lowercased and '_' mapped to '-' by normalizeLocale, an exact locale already registered by defineLocale is honoured first, and only the canonical string may reach require('./locale/' + name); the decision lives in loadLocale (src/lib/locale/locales.js), and updateLocale must resolve the same normalized identity before it merges or creates a locale.

landing_point.why: isLocaleNameSane is the only gate before the dynamic require at src/lib/locale/locales.js:85, and its own comment says it prevents names that look like filesystem paths, so anyone reading 'path traversal via locale name' starts here.

fix_sites.module_kind: internal validation predicate in the locale loader

fix_sites.entry_point: every getLocale route (src/lib/locale/locales.js:237), plus defineLocale parentLocale (:142) and updateLocale (:189), all funnelling into loadLocale

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/lib/locale/locales.js:178-202 (updateLocale: loadLocale(name) at :189 feeds mergeConfigs and the cache write locales[name] at :202)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: updateLocale() is an update/merge API whose job is to create or extend a locale, not to load a module, so a report about the loader's require path leaves it alone; likewise the checked-in moment.js / dist/ / min/ bundles read as generated output, not editable source.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Case- and underscore-insensitive locale lookup with substring fallback must keep working: moment.locale('EN') -> 'en', moment.locale('EN_gb') -> 'en-gb', moment.locale('fr-crap') -> 'fr', and a mixed-case custom locale registered with defineLocale ('Mixed_Custom') must still resolve by its exact name. A fix that validates the raw name against a strict canonical regex, without normalizing first and without checking the exact registered name first, breaks all of these.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a locale-alias table inside chooseLocale (e.g. 'zh_TW' -> 'zh-tw', 'no' -> 'nb') that maps a user name to a module name before loadLocale
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: moment already documents case/underscore aliases and substring fallback here, so an alias resolver in the same function is the natural next feature a maintainer would add.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second lazy-load route for a config-supplied parentLocale name (the de_test / localeFamilies mechanism) that appends the name to a require path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: parentLocale is already a config-supplied name that reaches loadLocale and is queued in localeFamilies when missing; an alias or legacy-name table would sit exactly here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new deprecated wrapper (like hooks.lang / hooks.langData) that forwards its key straight to loadLocale, bypassing getLocale's normalisation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the file keeps backwards-compatible aliases for old locale APIs, and each one is a thin pass-through that could skip the normalising getLocale short-circuit.

O9_family: path traversal via an unsanitised dynamic module path (CWE-27), triggered by locale-name input that is not canonicalised before require()
